name: Steal an Egg for Squishy Dumplings!
desc:
🥚 Welcome to Steal an Egg for Squishy Dumplings!

How to Play:
🥚 Steal eggs from Squishy Dumplings
🐣 Hatch eggs to collect rare Dumplings
💰 Earn money from your Squishy
⬆️ Upgrade your treadmill and base
🏃 Train on the treadmill to gain Speed
✨ Discover rarer eggs, squishy dumplings, sizes

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
